definitions: To begin to do something as a habit or regularly.
To develop a liking or an aptitude for something.
To go to a place, especially for safety or shelter.
To be attracted to someone or something; to like someone or something.
examples: She's taken to waking up early.
He's taken to painting in his spare time.
The birds have taken to the new bird feeder.
I've really taken to my new colleagues.
They took to the hills when the storm started.
